GOTRUE_API_HOST.description: Bind address for the GoTrue API server.

GOTRUE_DB_DATABASE_URL.description: PostgreSQL connection string for GoTrue. Uses private networking.

GOTRUE_JWT_SECRET.description: HS256 secret for signing JWTs. References the shared JWT_SECRET.

API_EXTERNAL_URL.description: Public URL of the Kong gateway — external-facing API URL for GoTrue.

GOTRUE_SITE_URL.description: Site URL for redirect flows. Uses Kong public domain.

GOTRUE_URI_ALLOW_LIST.description: Comma-separated list of allowed redirect URIs.

GOTRUE_MAILER_AUTOCONFIRM.description: Auto-confirm user emails on signup (development mode).

GOTRUE_SMTP_HOST.description: SMTP host for email sending (empty for no email).
